messages:
maria_support: Customer reports `invalid_json` on function/tool calls when using JSON mode. They say it worked earlier but now some requests 400/500 with parse errors.

maria_support: Repro notes from customer (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/infer?mode=json HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 65536
User-Agent: RedwoodSDK/2.1.0

{\"action\":\"charge\",\"amount\":1200,\"payment\":{\"type\":\"card\",\"card_number\":\"[redacted]\"}}
```

response snippet: ``{"error":"invalid_json","message":"unexpected end of input"}``

tim_oncall: Can you paste the raw request/headers + router logs (redact PCI) and the exact request id/time?

maria_support: Got request id `abc123` and time `2026-03-16T18:02:12Z`. Router log (staging trimmed):
```
2026-03-16T18:02:12Z ERROR parse_request: EOF while reading body for req id=abc123 src=10.0.0.5
2026-03-16T18:02:12Z WARN ingress: client disconnect during body read id=abc123
```

raj_repro: Intermittent + correlates with ~64KB bodies -> suspicious for ingress/nginx `client_max_body_size` or body buffering truncation. Also check SDK: v2.1.0 had a bug around chunked vs content-length in edge cases.

maria_support: Customer says they sometimes reproduce with raw curl `--data-binary @payload.json` (payload ~65KB). Sometimes success, sometimes `500 invalid_json`.

deploy-bot: ingress-nginx: 412 request body too large: client 10.0.0.5 blocked (reported by edge).

tim_oncall: OK probable root causes: 1) ingress body limit/truncation -> parser sees EOF -> `invalid_json`; 2) SDK misreporting Content-Length causing incomplete read. Quick triage: raise `client_max_body_size` to 1m on staging ingress and have QA re-run the payload. Also ask SDK team to validate Content-Length handling in 2.1.0.

raj_repro: I'll repro on staging now with `client_max_body_size 1m` and run the exact customer payload in loop to catch intermittency. If that fixes it we'll push a hotfix to prod ingress config and add a runtime check to surface `incomplete_body` / `413` instead of generic parse error.

maria_support: Customer notified: "we're investigating, will follow up after staging test, thx for the request id" :thumbsup:

tim_oncall: Followups: (1) Raj to open internal ticket with repro steps + edge logs + SDK metadata (user agent, version). (2) Add clearer runtime validation for truncated body -> return `413`/`incomplete_body`. (3) If SDK bug confirmed, coordinate a patch or recommend upgrade to customer. Assigning to @raj_repro.

raj_repro: Opening ticket now and starting staging run. Will post results and PR link in this thread.

maria_support: Thanks — will keep customer updated and escalate to enterprise CS if they need immediate mitigation.
